items.note: question. Should it be wired or removed? Nothing in labkit produces its `HitResult` argument, because the trial's canvas dispatcher has no hit-test (`affordanceAt`/`classifyTarget`). Wiring it means changing the signature to take a world point, claiming the press so it outranks pan (their registration order isn't stable), carrying the item with ghost and feedback, and making the pick-up plus drop one undo step. That's a feature arc, and removing it is a breaking change. Filed as a P2 TODO entry in 335912fe14, closing when a declared `pickUp` starts a drag or the option and `HitResult` are gone.
